Carrier checks on a quiet handover
This page teaches why the Companion Animal Travel Desk matters and how a careful handoff keeps each trip calm from booking through pickup. At Aurelia Skyways, we treat pet travel as a shared record, not a side note, so every detail must move cleanly between the desk, the cabin team, and the ground team. New staff should use a warm, steady tone, keep notes clear, and stay alert for anything that could affect comfort or safety.

When you speak with travelers, keep the conversation plain and practical. Explain what documents are needed, confirm crate condition, and note feeding or medication instructions exactly as given. If a traveler mentions stress, motion issues, or a need for extra care, record it right away so the right team sees it. The desk also needs to pass along any special handling points in language that crews can follow without confusion. It helps to read back the key facts before closing the file, because small errors can lead to delay or distress for the animal.

Desk note: <<FACT F050>>. Use that detail only as part of the official record and keep the rest of the handover simple. The same applies when you are working with other partner routes and shared service notes. Desk note: <<FACT F046>>. Leave space for crew updates, because clean records make it easier to respond if plans change.

Aurelia Skyways relies on steady habits here: listen well, write clearly, and pass every pet file with care. Remember that a quiet, complete handover protects the traveler, the animal, and the whole journey.
